lessons_used: Moving sign-in post-adoption (+13.3%, underpredicted) or post-certificate (+5.8%, overpredicted) was helpful, while placing sign-in after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%) and hand-off timing had no clear effect. Account sync banners were helpful (+2.7%, overpredicted), but pet sync verification hints showed no clear effect.

Path clarity headline updates were helpful (+5.9%, underpredicted), whereas path copy simplification, value proposition refreshes, clear outcome headlines, and time expectation banners showed no clear effect.

Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%, overpredicted) and background hatching readiness status (+3.3%, underpredicted) were helpful, but 3D progress trackers and detailed progress details showed no clear effect.

Photo quality guides with companion preview were helpful (+7.6%, overpredicted), while compact grid layouts (-7.7%) and photo fallback flows (-11.8%) made results worse; split upload assistants showed no clear effect.

System tray location notification tips were helpful (+3.8%), but first interaction tips made results worse (-6.5%), and sound notifications, spawn alerts, mascot welcome stages, and interaction badges showed no clear effect.

lessons_next: Moving sign-in post-adoption (+13.3%, underpredicted) or post-certificate (+5.8%, overpredicted) was helpful, while placing sign-in after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%) and hand-off timing showed no clear effect.
Multi-device account sync banners were helpful (+2.7%, overpredicted), but pet sync verification hints and pet restoration callouts showed no clear effect.

Path clarity headline updates were helpful (+5.9%, underpredicted), whereas copy simplification, value refreshes, clear outcome headlines, value focus refreshes, and time expectation banners showed no clear effect.

Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%, overpredicted) and background hatching readiness status (+3.3%, underpredicted) were helpful, but 3D progress trackers, progress details, animation progress status, sound notifications, and spawn alerts showed no clear effect.

Photo quality guides with companion preview were helpful (+7.6%, overpredicted), while compact grid layouts (-7.7%), photo fallback flows (-11.8%), and custom photo guidelines banners (-5.0%) made results worse; split upload assistants showed no clear effect.
